name: AnimTransition
doc: A state transition. Serialized list order defines deterministic priority.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: Stable transition ID for tools and graph mapping.

fields.name: duration
fields.doc: Fixed cross-fade duration; zero switches before advancing this tick.

fields.name: exitTick
fields.doc: Optional earliest elapsed state tick; duration waits for one complete cycle.

fields.name: conditions
fields.doc: Typed AND predicates; empty means unconditional.
